about.headline: Design that drives results.
paragraphs: I'm a graphic designer who knows marketing from the inside. I set up and optimize Meta Ads campaigns myself, run social media, and as co-founder of Doin Digital I see which creatives really work. That's why I design with results in mind, not just looks.

I use AI to automate repetitive tasks and deliver more, faster. I'm independent, well organized and clear in communication, and I test new tools with curiosity. I want to keep growing in marketing, combining design with data.

contact.description: Want to talk? Send me a message - I'll reply as soon as I can.

fuoco-nero.title: Fuoco Nero - Premium Coffee Brand Website
fuoco-nero.headline: Website for a premium coffee brand
fuoco-nero.description: Fuoco Nero is an exclusive premium coffee brand created for true connoisseurs. Its visual identity is built on a **dark, elegant aesthetic**, strong contrasts, and refined details that emphasize the luxurious character of the product - from packaging to the digital experience.
fuoco-nero.name: Fuoco Nero
fuoco-nero.short: Premium coffee for connoisseurs - a dark, elegant style with strong contrasts.

vasabi.title: Vasabi - Restaurant Menu
vasabi.headline: Japanese-Asian restaurant menu
vasabi.description: Vasabi restaurant menu design combines **modern minimalism** with **traditional Japanese aesthetics**. The goal was to create a visual identity that feels both **elegant and authentic**, reflecting the fusion of Japanese and Asian cuisine.
vasabi.name: Vasabi
vasabi.short: Modern minimalism combined with traditional Japanese aesthetics.

core-motion-physiotherapy.title: Coremotion Physiotherapy - Brochure
core-motion-physiotherapy.headline: Physiotherapy clinic brochure
core-motion-physiotherapy.description: The **Coremotion Physiotherapy** brochure was designed to communicate the clinic’s mission of _“Pain-Free Living”_ while providing essential information about their physiotherapy services in a clear and approachable way. The tri-fold format ensures a professional and practical layout, perfect for distribution in clinics, community centers, and wellness events.
core-motion-physiotherapy.name: Coremotion Physiotherapy
core-motion-physiotherapy.short: A clinic brochure built around “Pain-Free Living” - services explained clearly.

kvisual.title: Branding / Visual identity design - Kvisual
kvisual.headline: Visual identity for a design studio
kvisual.description: Kvisual is a **modern graphic design studio** specializing in visual identity design, advertising materials, and promotional campaigns. The brand combines **simplicity with expressiveness**, using clean lines, contrasting colors (black, white, and creative purple #6020B8), and a **geometric, futuristic-inspired logo**.
kvisual.name: Kvisual
kvisual.short: A design studio brand - simple, expressive, with a geometric futuristic logo.
